comparison.objective: Unpack a supported optical instrument and collect its foam inserts without dropping or tipping it.
comparison.physical_skill: Protective-support removal, safe transfer, and coordinated handling of fragile contents and packing pieces.
comparison.success_condition: Available evidence requires safe released placement of the instrument and collection of both inserts, with historical excessive tilt or unsupported descent invalidating success; full numeric rubric details are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests safe unpacking and support management for a fragile instrument, not deliberate controlled fracture or recovery of millimetre-scale metal tangs. Missing detailed thresholds do not suggest overlap.
